Priyom / team — forwarding a draft discount matrix and approval guidance for KOM-402. High level thoughts:

- Baseline offer: 18% on list for a 24-month, 500-GPU equivalent commit with staged activation.
- Tenor uplift: +4% discount for every additional 12 months up to 36 months.
- Volume tilt: If committed capacity exceeds 750-GPU equivalent we can extend to 24% base discount.
- Market protection: offer a price-index clause with a 10% band before pass-through; above 25% we propose a shared mitigation (partial credits + temporary indexation).

Approval ladder:
- Discounts <= 20%: Sales + Finance regional lead sign-off (LA finance).
- Discounts > 20% and <= 30%: Require VP Finance + Head of Sales (Marissa) approval.
- Discounts > 30%: Executive (CRO/CFO) escalation — unlikely but reserve escalation path.

Notes / edge cases:
- If Komodore demands a floor (no pass-through below X) we should price that into the base.
- If they want an automatic clawback if GPU costs drop >15%, legal must sign the mechanism specifics.

Marissa / Laura — please confirm if the approval ladder looks right for a strategic account; happy to package the ask so it reads well for VP/exec.

— Karthik

Alicia — following up with a succinct proposal and next steps so we can get internal approvals moving. Forwarding Karthik's matrix and attaching the commit term draft.

Proposal summary (KOM-402):
- Structure: 24-month reserved commit, 3-stage activation (month 0 / month 3 / month 6).
- Baseline: 500 GPU-equivalent units, with a 750-tier that increases discount by 4 pp.
- Pricing protection: Price-index clause with a 10% trigger; shared mitigation between 10–25% (credits + temporary surcharge); full pass-through above 25%.
- Approval ask: authorize a final discount up to 24% (Marissa/VP Finance sign-off). Anything above 24% must be routed to Marissa for VP-level approval.

Ask from Komodore: open to staged commit and indexation, but they want the option to top-up committed capacity at month-6 without resetting tier pricing. I've proposed that top-ups beyond agreed thresholds only apply to new tranches (preserve original tranche pricing).

Next steps:

2) If accepted, I'll route final ask to Marissa and Finance with the redline and discount request (target: <=24%).
3) Legal will prepare the LOI/contract language; draft LOI link here: https://docs.google.com/d/1Komodore-LOI
